sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho, singsi?
Mamaan aca, kiso hani?
Fangcal to!
O mitiliday ho kiso?
Hai, o mitiliday ho kako.
O mitiliday ho cingra?
Caayay, o singsi cingra.
Katomireng!
Mita’ong!
Kamaro’!
Cima kiso?
Ci Sawmah kako.
Ci Mayaw ko ngangan nira?
Caayay, ci Kacaw ko ngangan nira.
O fa’inayan kako.
O fafahiyan kami.
O fa’inayan ci Panay?
Caayay, o fafahiyan cingra.
Ira ko waco ako.
O kohetingay ko cengel nira.
Maolah kako i cingraan.
Maolah cingra i takowanan.
Icowa ko singsi iso?
Ira ini cingra.
Icowa ko rawang namo?
Iraw ka’amisay a rawang.
O maan konian?
O parad koni, o ’anengan koni.
Kareteng kora ’anengan?
Kareteng ko parad, kahemaw ko ’anengan.
Cima kora tamdaw?
O ina ako cingra.
Mimanay ko tayal nira?
O malasingsiay cingra.
Icowa mateli iso ko impic?
Ira i fafaed no parad mateli ako.
Nima kora kahengangay a impic?
No singsiay kora kahengangay a impic.
Lalima ko paro no loma’ niyam.
Ira ko ama, o mama, o ina ato fafahiyan a safa ako.
sentences.chineseText: 有祖母、爸爸、媽媽、妹妹和我。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitilid kako i kosiyaw pitilidan.
Mitilid i yociyen ko fafahiyan a safa ako.
sentences.chineseText: 我的妹妹在幼稚園讀書。

sentences.indigenousText: Calaw kalomowad to maranam.
Aka ho, malali’op ho kako.
Harakaten, maapacaw to mitilid.
Hai, mafana’ to kako.
Pina to ko mihecaan iso?
Mo^etep to ko mihecaan ako.
Papina kamo malakaka?
Tatosa ko kaka ako to fa’inayan, cecay ko safa ako to fafahiyan.
sentences.chineseText: 我有兩個哥哥和一個妹妹。

sentences.indigenousText: Pina to ko mihecaan no safa iso?
^Enem ko mihecaan no safa ako.
Icowa ko loma’ iso?
I satimolan no fanaw ko loma’ ako.
I ngata no pitilidan ko loma’ iso?
Hai, i ngata no pitilidan ko loma’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我們的家在學校附近。

sentences.indigenousText: Rakat sa kako talapitilidan to romi’ami’ad.
Marang, na icowaay kiso?
Na i Posongay kako.
O tatalacowa kiso anodafak?
O tatalaKakacawan kako anodafak.
Naon han to ko rakat.
Fangcal ko romi’ad anini.
Talalotok ci mama a mi’adop.
Mifaca’ ci ina to riko’ i ’alo.
Misalama kako aci kaka ako i loma’.
Masadak to ko cidal.
Matayal ci mama aci ina.
Masadak to ko folad.
Minokay to ci mama aci ina.
Minengneng kami to fo’is.
Ma’orad to, ira ko linay iso?
Awa, masadak kako macidal ho ko romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 沒有，我出門時還出太陽耶。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko kayhi maolah kiso?
Aray, mangaay to!
Patiko han to ako anodafak kiso.
O maan ko cengel no kadit i kakarayan?
Kohcalay ko cengel no kadit i kakarayan.
Fangcal manengneng ko tilo ni Idek?
Hai, tadafangcal manengneng ko tilo ni Idek.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，彩虹看起來真美麗。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihay ko hana i pala.
Adihay ko talod i pala.
Seriw sa ko fali salipahak saan cangra.
sentences.chineseText: 微風吹來時它們很高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Matiya o mita’ongay ko hana.
Matiya o mipakpakay to kamay ko talod.
’Aloman ko widang ako.
Takaraw ci Namoh, poener ci Mayaw.
Malalok ci Panay, matoka ci Dongi.
Malakapot kami to romi’ami’ad a mitilid ato misalama.
sentences.chineseText: 我們每天一起唸書和玩耍。

sentences.indigenousText: Pasowal ko singsi tamiyanan.
Kangodoen ko mato’asay.
Kasasiolah, kadadama ato widang.
sentences.chineseText: 對朋友要相親相愛，互相幫助。

sentences.indigenousText: Aka kaapac talapitilidan.
Aka pila’om to payso.
Pahanhan to a mitilid, masadak kako a talapapotal.
Ira ko facidol i papotal no pitilidan.
sentences.chineseText: 教室的外面有一棵麵包樹。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko cecay a cirot i fafaed no facidol.
sentences.chineseText: 在麵包樹上有一隻畫眉鳥。

sentences.indigenousText: Tanoradiw sa kora cirot.
Maratar kiso faki!
Talacowa kiso Panay?
O kakeriden ni ina kako a paising.
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽要帶我去給醫生看。

sentences.indigenousText: Mamaan kiso?
Malalisan kako.
O maan ko kaolahan iso a miyatayat?
O miyakiway ko kaolahan ako.
Naw?
O sakanga’ay no tatirengan.
Mafana’ kiso a romadiw?
Hai, mafana’ kako romadiw to radiw no Pangcah.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我會唱阿美族的歌。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ masakero kiso?
Hai, fangcal ko kero ako.
Ano matira, tatata, masakero kita!
Pina to ko toki anini?
Falo to ko toki anini.
Pina ko toki lomowad kiso to dafak?
^Enem ko toki lomowad kako.
Pina ko toki mafoti’ kiso?
Siwa ira ko pangkiw no toki a mafoti’ kako.
Nga’ay ho, ci Kacaw kako, ira i loma’ ci Sonay?
Ci Sawmah kako, awaay i loma’ masadak cingra.
Hai! Ano hakowa minokay cingra?
Minokay cingra anohoni, talaen ho.
Talacowa kiso inacila?
Talalotok miliso’ ci akongan kami.
O maan ko sapatala ni akong i tamowanan?
O lawal, o toron ato dongec.
sentences.chineseText: 阿公請我們吃飛鼠肉、粢粑和藤心湯。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ kako micoka.
O mamicoka kako ci inaan.
Fangcal ko mata ni ina.
Ciladem ko fokes nira.
Micelem to ko cidal, to’eman to.
Masoni to ko Piyakong, saka to’emanan to.
sentences.chineseText: 將要天黑了，知更鳥叫了。

sentences.indigenousText: Masadak to ko folad.
Masoni to ko ekong.
Macidal anini a romi’ad?
Hai, fa’edet ko romi’ad anini.
Cikafong ci ina masadak?
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽外出的時候，有戴帽子嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Caayay, matawal nira a cikafong.
Manga’ay kako misalama to herek no lahok?
Aka, tata’ang ko ’orad i papotal.
Ano masaesa’ to, manga’ay kako a masadak?
sentences.chineseText: 如果雨停了，我可以出去嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Manga’ay to, hakereman pinokay to aka tawalen!
sentences.chineseText: 可以，不要忘了傍晚要回來喔！

sentences.indigenousText: Kahofocan ni ama anodafak.
Misatoron kami anodafak.
Sapakalafi niyam ci amaan.
Nanay malipahak tanektek cingra saan kami.
sentences.chineseText: 我們希望讓她高興健康。

sentences.indigenousText: Cima sao?
Ama, fawahen ho, ci Kolas aci Dongi kami.
Kamo aca, ma’ilol to kako tamowanan.
sentences.chineseText: 原來是你們，我好想念你們。

sentences.indigenousText: Ama, nanay malipahak kiso ko kahofocan no miso.
Mikecec to mata mitolon ci ama.
Minanay to nisafaloco’an nira.
Nanay fangcal ko kato’as namo.
Nanay lihaday a maemin ko kasaparod no loma’ ita.
sentences.chineseText: 希望我們各家庭都平安快樂。

sentences.indigenousText: Nanay makadofah ko kinaira toni a mihecaan.
Pina ko romi’ad to cecay a lipay?
Pito^ ko romi’ad to cecay a lipay.
Sakapina no pilipayan anini?
Pilipayan anini talakiwkay kami milihay.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是禮拜天我們去教會做禮拜。

sentences.indigenousText: Talolong ko nanom no ’alo to kaciherangan.
Nikaorira, pangta ko nanom no ’alo to kasienawan.
Kaciherangan to matini, mihifang to kami a mitilid.
sentences.chineseText: 現在是夏天，我們放暑假。

sentences.indigenousText: Kirami, adihay ko faliyos.
Mafaliyos anini, talapitilidan kamo?
sentences.chineseText: 今天颳颱風，你們需要上學嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Caay ka talapitilidan kami anini.
Aka kasadak to loma’ kamo!
Hai, mafana’ kami.
O laloodan to, marohem to ko mami’.
Ira ko kangdaway, kahengangay, kaliyalaway a cengel i ’apilis no lotok.
sentences.chineseText: 山坡上，有綠有紅也有黃。

sentences.indigenousText: Talalotok ca Panay a mipitpit to mami’.
Cahocaho matomes to ko fakar nangra.
sentences.chineseText: 他們的簍子，一下子就裝滿了。

sentences.indigenousText: O mafoloday a kakonah kami.
Malalok matayal kami.
O matefaday i sasera a posak ato fao i.
sentences.chineseText: 掉在地上的飯粒和蟲類。

sentences.indigenousText: Liliden niyam a panokay.
O malalokay a kakonah kami.
sentences.chineseText: 我們是一群勤快的螞蟻。

sentences.indigenousText: Icowa to ci Mayaw ato ci Namoh?
I kacomikayan malalifet cangra a comikay.
Cima ko hacikayay nangra?
Ci Mayaw, nawhan saromi’ami’ad sa misa’icel minanam cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 是Mayaw呀，因為他每天很努力的練習。

sentences.indigenousText: Malingaday ko mama ako.
Ngorngor sa cingra matayal i omah.
sentences.chineseText: 他每天辛苦地在田裡耕作。

sentences.indigenousText: Pataeta’ sa to fongoh i cidacidalan.
Mara’oteng no ciferang ko riko’ ningra.
Anini mihecaan, makadofah ko pinaloma.
Lipahak sa ci mama a matawa.
Ira ko koliciw ako.
Pakakoliciw kako talapitilidan to romi’ami’ad.
Ira ko cecay a romi’ad, to saka talapitilidan a lalan.
Maledat ko koliciw no mako.
Ira mita’elif ko cecay a faki.
Sanga’en ningra ko koliciw ako.
Pakamaan kiso tala-Taypak?
Pakacinamalay.
Pina ko toki tahira?
Maedeng tolo tatokian.
Icowaay ko harakatay no cinamalay ato pasu?
sentences.chineseText: 火車和公車哪一個比較快呢？

sentences.indigenousText: O cinamalay ko harakatay.
Adihay ko tosiya i lalan.
Na’onen ko karomakat.
Kasatisil a mikalic to pasu.
Kacihilomit pakaotofay.
sentences.chineseText: 騎摩托車一定要戴安全帽。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihay ko lotok no Taywan.
O satakaraway a lotok no Taywan ko I-san.
Ira ko lotok no niyaro’ ita?
sentences.chineseText: 我們的部落附近有山嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Ira, adihay ko lotok no niyaro’ ita.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我們的部落有很多山。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko takaraway, ira ko poeneray.
sentences.chineseText: 有的比較高，有的比較矮。

sentences.indigenousText: Licayaw ho, icowa ko Cilangasan?
I sa’amisan no Makota’ay.
Maanen talaniyaro’ no Makota’ay?
Pasi’amis han ko rakat tangasa to.
Maraay a rakaten?
Maala ko pangkiw no toki.
O maan ko paro no riyar?
Ira ko foting, cekiw ato ’orang i riyar.
Pina ko wa’ay no ’orang?
Mo^etep ko wa’ay no ’orang.
Masamaan nanomen ko nanom no riyar?
Arenim a nanomen.
Mararid talariyar mifoting ko mifotingay.
Ano tata’ata’ang ko fali.
Takarakaraw ko tapelik.
Caay ka talaw cangra.
Caay kaeca matomes ko tamina nangra to foting ato ’afar.
sentences.chineseText: 他們的船上總是裝滿了魚和蝦。

sentences.indigenousText: Ina, ira to kako minokay.
A! Ira to kiso a minokay!
Macahiw kako.
O maan ko kaolahan iso?
Saka komaenan kako to konga.
Hai, ira i parad ko konga ala han.

lessons.title: O maan ko kaolahan iso a komaen

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko kaolahan iso a komaen?
O hemay ko kaolahan ako, kiso i?
O toron ko hanako, caay kaolah kako to hemay.
sentences.chineseText: 我喜歡吃糯米糕，不喜歡吃飯。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko sapisatoron, mafana’ kiso?
sentences.chineseText: 你知道糯米糕是用什麼做的嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ kako, o falinono ko sapisatoron.
sentences.chineseText: 我知道，用糯米做糯米糕。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho, itini maro’, o maan ko kaolahan iso a komaen?
sentences.chineseText: 你好，請坐，請問你要吃什麼？

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko hemay?
Awaay ko hemay itini, edeng o walay aca.
Nga’ay to, o walay ko han ako.
Maolah kiso to kaedahay?
Na’ay, matalaw kako komaen to kaedahay.
Sowalen da, o maamaan a hecian no losay ko iraay itini i Taywan?
sentences.chineseText: 請說說看，台灣有哪些水果？

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko kiyafes, o kowa’, o pawli, ira ho ko masamaanay…
sentences.chineseText: 有芭樂、木瓜和香蕉，還有很多很多。

sentences.indigenousText: Komaen to heci no losay kiso to romi’ami’ad?
Caayay ka halikaen kako to heci no losay.
Ka halikaen to heci no losay, ta fangcal ko tatirengan.
sentences.chineseText: 多吃水果，身體才會健康。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko losay no loma’ namo?
Ira, i ’a’ayawan no loma’ niyam ko kiyafes, ira i sa’ikoran ko ’alopal.
sentences.chineseText: 有，我們家前面有芭樂，後面也有柿子。

sentences.indigenousText: Ciheci to mihecahecaan kora losay?
sentences.chineseText: 那些果樹每年結果實嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hai, fangcal ko mihecaan anini, saka, malofic ko heci.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，今年天候好，所以結很多果實。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko lidaw i pin-syang?
Ira, o mi’acaan ni mama inacila.
Faedet ko romi’ad, cikciken ako kaenen ita!
sentences.chineseText: 天氣很熱，我切一切我們來吃吧！

sentences.indigenousText: Hayda, pacilahen to mamang ta kaeso’ a kaenen.
Adada ko wadis ako, singsi.
Adihay sato ko mikaenan iso to waneng, saka mangohed to ko wadis.
sentences.chineseText: 你吃太多糖果了，所以牙齒長蛀牙。

sentences.indigenousText: Maanen ako matiya?
Tangsolen paising, aka to ka halikaen to waneng, kalalok a miri’iw to wadis.
sentences.chineseText: 今後不要再貪吃糖果了，多刷牙。

sentences.indigenousText: Masatamdaway a wawa saan ko singsi a palata’ang i takowanan.
sentences.chineseText: 老師稱讚我是一個很乖的孩子。

sentences.indigenousText: Nawhani, i ’ayaw no kaen monanaw kako to kamay.
sentences.chineseText: 因為，我在吃飯之前會洗手。

sentences.indigenousText: Maemin ako a komaen ko kakaenen i kaysing.
sentences.chineseText: 我把碗裡的飯菜吃完了。

sentences.indigenousText: Maherek komaen, miri’iw kako to wadis.
Mafana’ haca kako a mipadang mifanaw to kaysing, to sala ato ’alapit.
sentences.chineseText: 我還會幫忙洗碗盤和筷子。

sentences.indigenousText: O sakalahok anini, ira ko titi no ’ayam, o fita’ol, o kalitang ato lokot.
sentences.chineseText: 今天的午餐有雞肉、蛋、四季豆，還有山蘇。

sentences.indigenousText: O patodongan a sakalahok namo i pitilidan konini?
sentences.chineseText: 這些是學校的營養午餐嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hai, o mipatalaan no pitilidan konini i tamiyanan.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，這些是學校為我們準備的。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafecol kamo?
Hai, kaeso’ ko sakalahok niyam.
Misalama kako i dafak, malitosor a matolo’.
sentences.chineseText: 今天早上我在玩耍的時候，跌倒了。

sentences.indigenousText: Madoka’, maremes ko tosor ako.
Paiyoen, tafoen no singsi ko doka’ ako.
Talacowa romakat to anini, mapi’iw ho kako.
sentences.chineseText: 我雖然現在走路一跛一跛地。

sentences.indigenousText: Nikaorira o mamaadah ko doka’ ako anocila.
Wawaaw, o maan ko a’acaen iso?
Tawki, mi’aca kako to impic ato ciwming.
sentences.chineseText: 老闆，我要買鉛筆和筆記本。

sentences.indigenousText: Pina ko a’acaen iso?
Cecay ko impic, cecay ko ciwming.
sentences.chineseText: 鉛筆一枝，筆記本也一本。

sentences.indigenousText: Lima rimo^od ko impic, siwa rimo^od ko ciwming.
sentences.chineseText: 鉛筆一枝五元，筆記本一本九元。

sentences.indigenousText: Polong han ko lima ato siwa i, safaw ira ko se^pat ko payso.
Tawki, semo’otay ko payso ako, sapi falican kako to payci.
sentences.chineseText: 老闆，我有一百元，想要換錢。

sentences.indigenousText: Maanen iso a mifalic?
Falicen ako to mo^etep a mo^etepay a payci.
Cecay, tosa, tolo, se^pat, lima, ^enem, pito^, falo, siwa. Aya! Cango’otay to saka mo^etep.
sentences.chineseText: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九。哎呀！不夠到十個。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay to, patongal han pafeli kako to tosa a limaay rimood.
sentences.chineseText: 沒關係，你可以再給我兩個五元。

sentences.indigenousText: Pafelien ni ina kako to lima polo’ a rimood to paylipayan.
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽每星期給我五十元。

sentences.indigenousText: Na’angen ako ko tosa polo’ a rimood.
O aadihay ko payso ako ano mato’as to.
sentences.chineseText: 我長大之後就會有很多錢。

sentences.indigenousText: Somowal ko singsi, “Malalok a mina’ang mala adihayay to” saan.
So’linay kona sowal.
Tosa ko rinom no toki,
o kakaya’ay ato kamoko’ay.
Harakatay ko rakat no kakaya’ay a rinom.
Matayo ko rakat no kamoko’ay a rinom.
Nanodafak tangasa to dadaya, caay katomerep a romakat.
sentences.chineseText: 從早上到晚上，不停地走。

sentences.indigenousText: Matiya kalimelaen ko romi’ad, sanay i kitaanan.
sentences.chineseText: 好像在告訴我們，要愛惜時間。

sentences.indigenousText: Pafeli ci mama ako to falohay a toki.
Satokien ako to romi’ami’ad.
Tiktak tiktak saan ko soni nira.
sentences.chineseText: 它發出滴答滴答的聲音。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano talapitilidan to anca minokay to,
mipalalay i takowanan a papido^edo to rakat no cikang.

lessons.title: O tayal ni ina to cecay a romi’ad

sentences.indigenousText: Palalen ni ina kako, to ^enem toki to dafak.
sentences.chineseText: 早上六點鐘，媽媽叫我起床。

sentences.indigenousText: Kalahokan i, misakalahok cingra.
Herek no lahok, tayra ci faian minanam a miteno’oy.
sentences.chineseText: 下午，到阿姨家學習織布。

sentences.indigenousText: Lafii^ to, mataya:l ho cingra.
Nano dafak tangasa lafii^, caay ho pasela’ cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 從早上到晚上，她從來不休息。

sentences.indigenousText: Tadamaroray ci ina.
Mamo^etep ko siri ni Kolas,
saromi’ami’ad saan cingra a pakaen to siri.
Sa’osien, ira ko masidayay hakiya?
Cecay, tosa, tolo, se^pat, lima, ^enem, pito^, falo, siwa, awaay ko cecay.
sentences.chineseText: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九，少了一隻。

sentences.indigenousText: Kalamkamen a mikilim, ano icowaay cingra?
sentences.chineseText: 趕快去找，不論牠在哪裡？

sentences.indigenousText: Matama to, itira i aikor no ’ongcoy a milimek.
sentences.chineseText: 找到了，原來在大石頭的後面躲藏。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolah ko ’oner a masadak to dadaya.
Mararid itira i semosemotan ato i fokelokelohan a milimek cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 牠經常躲在草叢中和石縫堆裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Mangatowa’ ko ngoyos ira, awaay ko pakalaliway a ’edo^ ato takola’.
sentences.chineseText: 牠嘴巴一張開，老鼠和青蛙都很難逃開。

sentences.indigenousText: Makapahay a nenengen ko ’adipangpang.
Sarakat i, o fafayoh ho cingra.
Ikorto i, cica’edong to cingra to cisapikpikay,
sentences.chineseText: 後來，它穿著美麗的翼衣服，

sentences.indigenousText: i hanahanaan to a misaefeefer.
Pina’on! Tahasifedaw i salil no falalotong.
sentences.chineseText: 小心！別掉進蜘蛛的陷阱裡。

lessons.title: Nawiro kahengang ko hemot no lotong?
lessons.titleCh: 猴子的屁股為什麼是紅色的？

sentences.indigenousText: O kimad iti:ya ho, samsaman no lotong ko ’alem.
Sapipasadakan cingra to ’alem, panamalen ningra ko dihif no lotok.
sentences.chineseText: 放火燒洞穴，想要使穿山甲出來，

sentences.indigenousText: ’Araw han i, tata’ang a tata’ang ko namal,
matodoh ko hemot no tireng to.
Nanoya to, mala kahengangay to ko hemot no lotong.
sentences.chineseText: 從那時候起，猴子的屁股就變成紅色了。

lessons.title: Mafana’ kako a somowal to no ’Amis

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ kiso a somowal to no ’Amis?
Pangta ko kafana’an ako, minanam ho kako anini.
I cowa kiso a minanam to sowal no ’Amis?
I pitilidan kako a minanam.
Lahoday a nanamen ko sowal no ’Amis?
Lahoday a nanamen, tada kaolahan to.
O Yin-cu-min kamo?
Hai, o Yin-cu-min kami.
O Iwatan kamo haw?
Caayay, o ’Amis kami.
O ’Amis ko sa’alomanay i niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 我們村子裡的人大多是阿美族。

sentences.indigenousText: Masilsil i satimolan sawali no Taywan ko ’Amis.
sentences.chineseText: 我們阿美族分佈在台灣的東南部。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ ci akong a pakimad.
Mararid kako a maro’ i lidong no kilang, a mitengil to pipakimad ni akong.
sentences.chineseText: 我常常坐在樹蔭下，聽阿公講故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ cingra to adihayay a fangcalay a kimad.
sentences.chineseText: 他知道許多精彩的故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano o kalipahakan ato kararoman to a kimad, malalen ko olah ako a mitengil.
sentences.chineseText: 不論是快樂或是悲傷的故事，我都很喜歡聽。

sentences.indigenousText: Cima ko mite^kaay misanga’ to tingwa?
I cowa ko satakaraway a loma’?
O maan ko sakasasela’ no foting?
Naw makakeleng ko kakarayan?
I cowa mikilim to sakafana’?
I cudad. Malalok a misa’osi, matongal ko fana’ no mita.
sentences.chineseText: 在書裡。用功讀書，可以讓我們增加知識。

sentences.indigenousText: Na misa’osi to kiso toni Kolas Mahengheng a cudad haw?
sentences.chineseText: 你讀過Kolas Mahenhen的故事書嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Masa’osiay to ako, fangcal kona cudad.
Manga’ay caliwen ako kona cudad?
sentences.chineseText: 這本書我可以向你借嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Awaay kono mako, mafana’ kako iraay koni Panay, tanamen ako a micaliw cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 我沒有，我知道Panay有，我可以幫你借。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira i, pafeli han to kako, aray!
sentences.chineseText: 謝謝，如果借到的話，請你拿給我！

sentences.indigenousText: Malahakelong kako ato kapot a tayra i picakayan to cudad i nacila.
sentences.chineseText: 昨天我和同學一起到書店去。

sentences.indigenousText: Mangalay kami a micakay to citing ato cudad.
sentences.chineseText: 我們都想買字典和故事書。

sentences.indigenousText: Hinam han aca malecad ko micakayan niyam a citing.
sentences.chineseText: 結果我們兩人各買了一本相同的字典。

sentences.indigenousText: Nikaorira caay ka lecad ko micakayan niyam a cudad,
sentences.chineseText: 但是我們買的故事書卻不同，

sentences.indigenousText: o ni Diway a kimad ko micakayan ningra, o ni Isop ko micakayan ako.
sentences.chineseText: 他買的是Diway的神話故事，我買的是伊索寓言。

sentences.indigenousText: Talacowa caay ka lecad ko micakayan a cudad, kirami lalecad saan ko ’aca.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然買的書不同，可是，價錢是剛好相同。

sentences.indigenousText: Mihatatanam kako a mitilid to tilid.
Mangalay kako a kalamkam ko kafana’.
Ano mafana’ to kako a mitilid i,
patikamien ako ci kaka ako.
I Taypak cingra a matayal, tadama’ilol kako i cingranan.
sentences.chineseText: 他在台北工作，我很想念他。

sentences.indigenousText: Masamaanay to ko ’orip nangra hakiya?
sentences.chineseText: 不知道他們的生活過得怎麼樣？

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho! Kiso kaka.
Lipahak ko faloco’ ako, pakalayap to tikami iso anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天接到你的信，我非常高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolah kako toya pafelian iso i takowanan a cudad.
sentences.chineseText: 我很喜歡你送給我的書。

sentences.indigenousText: Malaheci ko pitilid iso, mamalasingsi to kiso saan ko katengilan.
sentences.chineseText: 聽說你畢業了，就要成為老師。

sentences.indigenousText: O mamisa’icel ho kako a mitilid.
Nanay matiya kiso a malasingsi kako.
sentences.chineseText: 希望我和你一樣將來當老師。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitilid kako to romi’ami’ad to re-ci.
Tiliden ako to romi’ami’ad ko malitemohay a demak.
sentences.chineseText: 我把每天發生的事記下來。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano mahaen, manga’ay kako a mihatatanam to tatiliden,
sentences.chineseText: 如果這樣，我也可以練習寫字，

sentences.indigenousText: manga’ay mapalowad ko mihadidiay a faloco’ ako.
I laloma’ no re-ci adihay ko mata’elifay to a demak ako.
sentences.chineseText: 日記裡有許多我過去的事。

sentences.indigenousText: O aa’imeren ako a mina’ang ko ninian.
Ciriko’ to kangdaway ko yofing.
Saromi’ami’ad saan a patangasa to tikami i tamdamdawan.
Ano ma’orad ato macidal to ko romi’ad i.
sentences.chineseText: 不管是晴天還是下雨天。

sentences.indigenousText: Hacecacecay han ningra ko tikami a patangasa i lomaloma’an.
sentences.chineseText: 他把信一封一封送到每個家。

sentences.indigenousText: Lipahak ko tamdaw a pakalayap to tikami.
Rahekeray to ko faloco’ no yofing.
sentences.chineseText: 郵差的心裡也感到很滿足。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano citama’ a mi’adop ko ’Amis i, mipalada’ to fiyafiyaw.
sentences.chineseText: 我們的族人去打獵有所捕獲，會把獵物分享給鄰居（親友）。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano cilafang i, pasadaken no ciloma’ay ko kaeso’ay a kakaenen.
sentences.chineseText: 如果朋友來拜訪，主人會把最美味的食物拿出來。

sentences.indigenousText: I piilisinan sato, misatoron, mipacok to fafoy, ato pasadak to ^ecaw cangra.
sentences.chineseText: 在部落裡舉行祭典時，他們舂打麻糬，殺豬，以及擺出釀造的小米酒。

sentences.indigenousText: O rayray no ’orip no tato’asan no ’Amis konini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是阿美族的傳統習俗。

sentences.indigenousText: Sowal sa ko mato’asay, “Mahengheng ko riyar o mama’orad; masadak ko topi o mamacidal sanay.”
sentences.chineseText: 老人常如此說：「隆隆海聲必降雨，鴿子飛翔必天晴。」

sentences.indigenousText: O tatodong nonini a sowal i,
ano matengil ko kahengheng no riyar to dadaya, caykanca o mama’orad ano dafak.
sentences.chineseText: 如果晚上聽見海發出隆隆的聲音，那麼第二天一定會下雨。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano masoni ko topi to dafak i, caykanca fangcal ko romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 如果早晨時聽見鴿子的叫聲，那麼天氣一定晴朗。

sentences.indigenousText: O malifetay no to’as i ’orip nangra konini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是袓先生活所累積的經驗。

sentences.indigenousText: Latek ira ko caayay kalaheci, nikaorira, o so’elinay konian.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然不一定可靠，但是通常很靈。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini a romi’ad, pasifana’ ko singsi misanga’ to datok ato ^epip.
sentences.chineseText: 今天老師教導製作口簧琴和竹笛。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko datok ato ^epip?
O mato’asay ko mitekaay a misanga’, o tekes ko sapisanga’ toni sasonien.
sentences.chineseText: 它是祖先發明的樂器，是用桂竹做成的。

sentences.indigenousText: O hakowa ko pisonian to datok ato ^epip?
sentences.chineseText: 什麼時侯可以吹口簧琴和竹笛？

sentences.indigenousText: Ano hakowa to a cikang manga’ay to a misoni.
Nikaorira, ano ci mapadesay ko loma’, tati’ih a misoni, nawhani, mapaysin.
sentences.chineseText: 但是如果家裡親人有喪事，就不能吹奏，否則會觸犯禁忌。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko sefi, pikacawan ato kiwkay i niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 我們的部落有集會所、瞭望台和教會。

sentences.indigenousText: O kasa’opoan no finawlan ko sefi.
sentences.chineseText: 集會所是族人聚集的地方。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i sacomod no niyaro’ ko pikacawan, o pikecoran a minengneng to rakat no ’ada.
sentences.chineseText: 瞭望台在部落的入口，用來觀察敵人的動靜。

sentences.indigenousText: O pipatosokan a mita’ong to Kawas ko kiwkay.
sentences.chineseText: 教會是專心敬拜神的地方。

sentences.indigenousText: O nano to’as ho ita a mipatirengan koni.
Ora ma’araway a niyaro’ i, o Kakacawan.
sentences.chineseText: 那個可以看到的部落是長濱。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko patiyamay, o payofingan ato paisingan itira.
sentences.chineseText: 那裡有商店、郵局和醫院。

sentences.indigenousText: Manga’ay kita a talapatiyamay a mi’aca to lalosidan.
sentences.chineseText: 我們可以到商店買東西。

sentences.indigenousText: Manga’ay a talapayofingan mina’ang, mitefad to payso ato paefer to tikami.
sentences.chineseText: 也可以到郵局存錢、領錢和寄信。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano adada i, manga’ay a talapaisingan a paising.
sentences.chineseText: 如果生病了，可以到醫院看病。

sentences.indigenousText: Onini a kalomipatirengan i, o sakarahoday no ’orip ita anini.
sentences.chineseText: 這些現代的設施，讓我們的生活方便。

sentences.indigenousText: Tosa no semo’otan ko tamdaw no Yin-cu-min i Taywan.
sentences.chineseText: 原住民的人口佔台灣總人口的百分之二。

sentences.indigenousText: Makalitosaay to ko tamdaw no i niyaro’ay.
sentences.chineseText: 大約還有一半的人住在部落裡。

sentences.indigenousText: O roma a kalitosa i, i tokay to a maro’.
sentences.chineseText: 另一半的人，已經住在都市裡了。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihay ko katayalan i tokay saka, masolot ko kapah ato kaying.
sentences.chineseText: 都市的工作機會多，所以吸引男女青年。

sentences.indigenousText: I tokay to a misaparod, matayal cangra.
sentences.chineseText: 他們已在都市成家，也在那裡工作。

sentences.indigenousText: Saka, ’aloman to ko teloc no Yin-cu-min i tokay a mato’as.
sentences.chineseText: 所以，現在有許多的原住民的後裔在都市成長。

sentences.indigenousText: Ilisin no niyaro’ niyam itira i sakapito^ a folad no mihecahecaan.
sentences.chineseText: 每年的七月間，我們的部落舉行「豐年祭」。

sentences.indigenousText: O satadamaanay a romi’ad no niyaro’ konini, o kasa’opoan heca no kasangasaw kona romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 這是部落最重要的日子，也是每個家族團聚的時刻。

sentences.indigenousText: Mapolong ko ’alomanay a romadiw ato masakero i potal, a malipahak to nika kadofah ko kinaira no pinaloma.
sentences.chineseText: 大家在廣場上唱歌和跳舞，來慶祝豐收。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini a mihecaan, na i Taypak a pakahikoki ko paro no loma’ no faki ako a minokay.
sentences.chineseText: 今年，舅舅全家人從台北搭飛機回來。

sentences.indigenousText: Pasowal ko kaka ako, “O kailisinan no niyaro’ ko kahinatalaan niyam i Taypakay.” saan.
sentences.chineseText: 哥哥說：「我們在台北最期待的，就是家鄉的豐年祭。」

sentences.indigenousText: Saikoray to a romi’ad no kakeroan no ilisin anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是豐年祭歌舞節目的最後一天。

sentences.indigenousText: Macakat i tongroh no loma’ no kakitaan ato a’isedan a mifarasi’ to ecaw, nanay masayir ko kaloadada no tamdaw o sanay.
sentences.chineseText: 女祭司爬上頭目的屋頂，向大眾撒甜酒以示驅邪並治好大眾各種疾病。

sentences.indigenousText: Miliyaw a macakat ko a’isedan a mifolesak to ngicingiciw no ’icep, nanay citama’ ko kapah a mi’adop, ato mifoting o sanay.
sentences.chineseText: 女祭司再次爬到宗祠的屋頂上，向大眾撒檳榔片，以示祝福部落青年上山打獵下海漁撈順利常有獵獲。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini, o palimo han to a palacecay ko pakomod ato pakeras.
sentences.chineseText: 今天，把pakomod（祈福）和pakeras（祝福）合併成為palimo（豐年祭最後一天的敬老與親睦之敬酒活動）。

sentences.indigenousText: Pararamoday han no ’Amis’ ko mipataloma’ay.
sentences.chineseText: 阿美族人講結婚典禮就是「使成為夫妻」的意思。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira ko pataloma’ay a demak i niyaro’, o tata’angay a demak no ngangasawan konian.
sentences.chineseText: 部落裡有人舉行結婚，是整個氏族的大事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mipatala to siraw ato ^ecaw ko loma’ no mipataloma’ay to malininaay.
sentences.chineseText: 舉行婚禮的家裡會準備鹹豬肉和糯米酒宴請親友。

sentences.indigenousText: Masasipakadang, pafati, pacangaw ko mipataloma’an.
sentences.chineseText: 舉行結婚典禮的要交換手環、戒指、項鍊等定情物。

sentences.indigenousText: Palimo’ot ko faki a somowal, mapalemed no finawlan cangra.
sentences.chineseText: 伯父會給他們訓話，族人會給他們祝福。

sentences.indigenousText: O pisawadan niyam a mitilid anini a romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是我們畢業的日子。

sentences.indigenousText: Tahidangen no pitilidan ko kalas no niyaro’ mipacakat i tamiyanan.
sentences.chineseText: 學校邀請部落長老為我們舉辦成年禮。

sentences.indigenousText: Papilifeten no kalas kami a mipana’.
Maparenget ko pakalifetay a mitiliday.
sentences.chineseText: 通過的學生才能戴上頭飾。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitolon ko mato’asay, palimo’ot a pa’icel i takowanan to saka lalok a matayal.
sentences.chineseText: 長老為我們祈福，並且勉勵我做事要認真。

sentences.indigenousText: Yo matengil ko radiw, matatoor kami a masadak nai pitilidan, misi’ayaw to fa^elohay a ’orip.
sentences.chineseText: 當聽到歌聲時，我們陸續走出學校，邁向新的人生。
